rows: Decision: port both. The installed check (`mobilecli apps list`, strict about the JSON shape, any failure counts as not installed), the cache under `$HOME/.cache/wf/expo-go/ios/54.0.7`, the download with `curl -sfL`, `tar -xzf` into a temp directory renamed with `mv`, `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine`, `xcrun simctl install`, and for `open-expo` the launch, the 1.5 s settle and the deep link. As in the TS, `open-expo` resolves the simulator twice. Oracle: `ios-expo-go.integration.test.ts` (12 tests; `mobilecli`, `xcrun`, `curl`, `tar` and `xattr` stubs, private HOME and TMPDIR), 12/12 on the TS bundle and on the Rust binary unchanged. Not exercised: a real download or Simulator. With this, only `ios build dev-client` and `ios launch` remain of the iOS group.
